urllib.request import boto3 from botocore.exceptions import ClientError REGION = os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "eu-north-1") ENABLED = os.environ.get("NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED", "false") == "true" LEDGER re.compile(r"^cs_live_[A-Za-z0-9]+$") ORDER = re.compile(r"^NUT-[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$") EVENT = re.compile(r"^evt_[A-Za-z0-9]+$") EMAIL = re.compile(r"^[^\s@<>]{1,64}@[^\s@<>]{1,180}$") def field(row, name, kind="S"): return (row.get(name) or {}).get(kind) def response(status, **values): return {"statusCode": status, "body": json.dumps(values, separators=(",", ":"))} def eligible(event): if field(event, "eventType") != "NUTRAXIN_PAYMENT_PAID": return None if field(event, "status") != "PENDING_REVIEW": return None key = event.get("pk", {}).get("S", "") order_id = key.removeprefix("ORDER#") if key.startswith("ORDER#") else "" sk = event.get("sk", {}).get("S", "") event_id = sk.removeprefix("PAYMENT_EVENT#") if sk.startswith("PAYMENT_EVENT#") else "" if not ORDER.fullmatch(order_id) or not EVENT.fullmatch(event_id): return None attempt_id = field(event, "paymentAttemptId") if not attempt_id or len(attempt_id) > 160: return None return order_id, event_id, attempt_id def read_paid_order(order_id, event_id): row = DDB.get_item(TableName=LEDGER, Key={ "pk": {"S": "ORDER#" + order_id}, "sk": {"S": "SUMMARY"} }, ConsistentRead=True).get("Item") or {} sid = field(row, "stripeSessionId") amount = field(row, "totalGrossMinor", "N") if (field(row, "orderId") != order_id or field(row, "status") != "PAID" or field(row, "lastStripeEventId") != event_id or not isinstance(sid, str) or not SESSION.fullmatch(sid) or not isinstance(amount, str) or not amount.isdecimal() or not 30 <= int(amount) <= 99999999 or field(row, "currency") != "GBP"): raise ValueError("Order is not a verified paid Nutraxin checkout") return row, sid, int(amount) def stripe_session(sid): token = credential not configured") url = "https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions/" + urllib.parse.quote(sid, safe="") req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token, "Accept": "application/json"}, method="GET") with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=8) as res: return json.loads(res.read(131072)) def verified_recipient(session, row, sid, order_id, attempt_id, amount): metadata = session.get("metadata") or {} if (session.get("id") != sid or session.get("livemode") is not True or session.get("mode") != "payment" or session.get("status") != "complete" or session.get("payment_status") != "paid" or session.get("currency") != "gbp" or session.get("amount_total") != amount or session.get("client_reference_id") != order_id or metadata.get("payment_attempt_id") != attempt_id or metadata.get("quote_version") != field(row, "quoteVersion") or metadata.get("customer_id") != field(row, "customerId")): raise ValueError("Stripe payment does not reconcile to the durable order") details = session.get("customer_details") or {} address = details.get("email") or session.get("customer_email") if not isinstance(address, str) or len(address) > 254 or not EMAIL.fullmatch(address): raise ValueError("Stripe confirmed email is unavailable") return address def claim(order_id, event_id): DDB.update_item(TableName=OUTBOX, Key={"pk": {"S": "ORDER#" + order_id}, "sk": {"S": "PAYMENT_EVENT#" + event_id}}, UpdateExpression="SET #s = :claim, claimedAt = :now", ConditionExpression="#s = :pending", ExpressionAttributeNames={"#s": "status"}, ExpressionAttributeValues={ ":claim": {"S": "SENDING"}, ":pending": {"S": "PENDING_REVIEW"}, ":now": {"N": str(int(time.time()))}}) def mark(order_id, event_id, status, message_id=None): values={":prev": {"S": "SENDING"}, ":status": {"S": status}, ":when": {"N": str(int(time.time()))}} update="SET #s = :status, processedAt = :when" if message_id: values[":id"]={"S": message_id} update += ", sesMessageId = :id" DDB.update_item(TableName=OUTBOX, Key={"pk": {"S": "ORDER#" + order_id}, "sk": {"S": "PAYMENT_EVENT#" + event_id}}, UpdateExpression=update, ConditionExpression="#s = :prev", receipt_lines(row, amount): lines = json.loads(field(row, "approvedLinesJson") or "[]") shipping_raw = field(row, "shippingGrossMinor", "N") if not isinstance(shipping_raw, str) or not shipping_raw.isdecimal(): raise ValueError("Verified shipping amount missing") shipping = int(shipping_raw) if not isinstance(lines, list) or not 1 <= len(lines) <= 100: raise ValueError("Verified order lines missing") cleaned = [] for line in lines: if not isinstance(line, dict): raise ValueError("Invalid order line") name, qty, gross = line.get("name"), line.get("quantity"), line.get("grossMinor") if (not isinstance(name, str) or not 1 <= len(name) <= 200 or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in name) or type(qty) is not int or not 1 <= qty <= 10000 or type(gross) is not int or not 0 to payment") return cleaned, shipping def order_date(session): stamp = session.get("created") if type(stamp) is not int or not 0 < stamp <= int(time.time()) + 300: return "" return """ return subject, body, html def send_receipt(address, order_id, amount, lines, shipping, name="", placed=""): subject, body, html = receipt_content(order_id, amount, lines, shipping, name, placed) return SES.send_email( FromEmailAddress="NovaPharm Healthcare <" + SENDER + ">", ReplyToAddresses=[SUPPORT], Destination={"ToAddresses": [address]}, Content={"Simple": { "Subject": {"Data": subject, "Charset": "UTF-8"}, "Body": {"Text": {"Data": body, "Charset": "UTF-8"}, "Html": {"Data": html, "Charset": "UTF-8"}}}}) def handler(event, context): if not ENABLED: return response(200, enabled=False, processed=0) if (not isinstance(event, dict) or event.get("source") != "aws.events" or event.get("detail-type") != "Scheduled Event"): return response(403, error="scheduler_only") status = SES.get_account() if status.get("ProductionAccessEnabled") is not True or status.get("SendingEnabled") is not True: return response(503, error="ses_production_access_not_approved") if SENDER.split("@")[-1].lower() != "novapharmhealthcare.com": return response(503, error="sender_domain_unapproved") records = [] cursor = None scan_incomplete = False # DynamoDB applies Limit BEFORE FilterExpression, so paginate or new # paid events can be hidden behind older nonmatching outbox entries. for page in range(250): options = {"TableName": OUTBOX, "ConsistentRead": True, "Limit": 100, "FilterExpression": "#s = :pending AND eventType = :paid", "ExpressionAttributeNames": {"#s": "status"}, "ExpressionAttributeValues": {":pending": {"S": "PENDING_REVIEW"}, ":paid": {"S": "NUTRAXIN_PAYMENT_PAID"}}} if cursor: options["ExclusiveStartKey"] = cursor scanned = DDB.scan(**options) records.extend(scanned.get("Items", [])) cursor = scanned.get("LastEvaluatedKey") if not cursor or len(records) >= 25: break else: scan_incomplete = bool(cursor) records = records[:25] sent = 0 review = 0 for outbox in records: ids = eligible(outbox) if not ids: continue order_id, event_id, attempt_id = ids try: row, sid, amount = read_paid_order(order_id, event_id) session = stripe_session(sid) recipient = verified_recipient(session, row, sid, order_id, attempt_id, amount) lines, shipping = receipt_lines(row, amount) except (ClientError, urllib.error.HTTPError, urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError): review += 1 continue try: claim(order_id, event_id) except ClientError: continue # If marking SENT fails after SES success, SENDING is deliberately # stranded for manual reconciliation; automatic retries could duplicate mail. mark(order_id, event_id, "SENT", delivered.get("MessageId")) sent += 1 return response(200, enabled=True, sent=sent, needs_review=review, scan_incomplete=scan_incomplete)
